title: I'll Fly Away
lyrics_original: Some bright morning when this life is over
To that home on Gods celestial shore
I'll fly away in the morning
When I die hallelujah by and by
When the shadows of this life have gone
Like a bird from these prison walls I'll fly
I'll fly away in the morning
When I die hallelujah by and by
Oh how glad and happy when we meet
No more cold iron shackles on my feet
I'll fly away in the morning
When I die hallelujah by and by
I'll fly away in the morning
When I die hallelujah by and by
Just a few more weary days and then
To a land where joys will never end
I'll fly away in the morning
When I die hallelujah by and by

bible_verses.telugu: మా ఆయుష్కాలము డెబ్బది సంవత్సరములు అధికబలమున్న యెడల ఎనుబది సంవత్సరములగును అయినను వాటి వైభవము ఆయాసమే దుఃఖమే అది త్వరగా గతించును మేము ఎగిరిపోవుదుము.
bible_verses.english: Our days may come to seventy years, or eighty, if our strength endures; yet the best of them are but trouble and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

bible_verses.telugu: ఆ మీదట సజీవులమై నిలిచియుండు మనము వారితోకూడ ఏకముగా ప్రభువును ఎదుర్కొనుటకు ఆకాశమండలమునకు మేఘములమీద కొనిపోబడుదుము. కాగా మనము సదాకాలము ప్రభువుతో కూడ ఉందుము.
bible_verses.english: After that, we who are still alive and are left will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever.

bible_verses.telugu: భూమిమీద మన గుడారమైన యీ నివాసము శిథిలమైపోయినను, చేతిపనికాక దేవునిచేత కట్ట బడినదియు నిత్యమైనదియునైన నివాసము పరలోకమందు మనకున్నదని యెరుగుదుము.
bible_verses.english: For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is destroyed, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for the incredible promise of an eternal home with You where shadows and pain will be no more. When life feels heavy or uncertain, fix my heart on the glory that awaits in Your presence. Fill me with Your peace and joy today as I live in the light of Your resurrection promise. Teach me to walk faithfully now, holding tightly to the eternal hope I have in Jesus. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for the incredible promise of an eternal home with You where shadows and pain will be no more. devotional.reflection_english: "I'll Fly Away" reminds us that our present troubles and earthly shadows are only temporary, pointing us toward an eternal home filled with God's glorious presence. As followers of Christ, we can face life's hardships not with despair, but with joyful anticipation of the day we will be fully united with our Savior. This beloved hymn invites us to lift our eyes above daily struggles and anchor our hearts in the resurrection hope promised to us. Let your spirit sing with gladness today, knowing your ultimate home is secure in Him.
